name: ChangeColumnDataTypeNode
label: Change Column Data Type
description: Casts one or more columns of a data table to a target data type.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The data table whose columns will be converted.

fields.name: TargetDataType
fields.label: Target Data Type
fields.description: The data type to convert the selected columns to.

selectOptions.label: String
selectOptions.description: Converts the column to a string (System.String).

selectOptions.label: Integer (Int32)
selectOptions.description: Converts the column to a 32-bit signed integer.

selectOptions.label: Long (Int64)
selectOptions.description: Converts the column to a 64-bit signed integer.

selectOptions.label: Decimal
selectOptions.description: Converts the column to a decimal (128-bit).

selectOptions.label: Double
selectOptions.description: Converts the column to a double-precision floating point.

selectOptions.label: DateTime
selectOptions.description: Converts the column to a date and time value.

selectOptions.label: Boolean
selectOptions.description: Converts the column to a boolean value.

selectOptions.label: Guid
selectOptions.description: Converts the column to a globally unique identifier.

fields.name: ConvertedDataTable
fields.label: Converted Data Table
fields.description: The data table with the converted column types.
